description: p8's input with `x_undefined: 1` added to its first attestation, the one by a party to the transaction (n122 adds it to the attestation by the attestor outside the parties). Every object in `attestations` is closed, whoever the attestor and wherever the entry sits, so the record rejects with unknown_member_reject. p8 is the accepting twin. An engine that checks only the last attestation, skips the first, or checks only attestors outside the parties accepts this vector. Rests on `defined_members` in MANIFEST.json.
